analysis.reasonEn: Maintaining a wait-and-see approach for the third consecutive session. RSI has slightly rebounded after entering oversold territory but remains below 40. MACD histogram shows improvement but stays negative. ADX at 31.3 indicates a clear trend, but -DI is higher than +DI, suggesting downward pressure dominance. Volume ratio at 1.15 against the 5-day average shows no significant momentum, deferring directional judgment.
